assign.request: Phase 2 of ai-server: move mechanical task logging into Claude Code hooks — first-touch action lines, Stop-gate on incomplete step ledgers, session resume/end lines. Bound: ~2KB per task, judgment lines stay AI-written.

log.msg: hooks reference read: PostToolUse gets tool_name/tool_input/tool_response; Stop carries stop_hook_active + accepts top-level {"decision":"block","reason"}; SessionStart source is startup|resume|clear|compact|fork; SessionEnd reason is clear|resume|logout|prompt_input_exit|bypass_permissions_disabled|other and discards all output.

fixture matrix: 34/34 pass — no-task silent x4 events, first-vs-repeat touch (incl. backslash path), 4 skip basenames, outside-repo + other-drive, Bash tool_input, NotebookEdit notebook_path, Stop blocks at 2/3 and allows on landed_at / last step / no steps / stop_hook_active, SessionStart startup-vs-resume, SessionEnd landed-vs-not, <page>/ai/<slug>/ shape, tmpdir cache + stale-cache rejection, junk stdin.

BLOCKER: writing .claude/settings.json is denied by the auto-mode classifier (both Write and Edit). Not routing around it — agent instructions forbid an agent authorizing its own config changes. The exact hooks block goes in .claude/hooks/readme.md for Mike to paste; live verification runs via claude -p --settings <temp file>, which configures one test subprocess without touching persistent config.

assign.now: live end-to-end green; docs + skill/CLAUDE.md notes landed

log.msg: LIVE BUG the fixtures missed: the Write tool creates task.jsonl with NO trailing newline, so appendFileSync glued the hook action onto the launch assign — one line, two objects, JSON.parse fails, BOTH lines vanish from every reader. append() now sniffs the last byte and prefixes a newline. Fixture added.

LIVE Stop-gate test: the gate blocked haiku at step 1 of 3 and the loop guard held (18s, exit 0). But haiku answered the spec reason string with {"landed_at": {...}} as a TOP-LEVEL verb — not a landing — and SessionEnd correctly caught it with "without landing". Rewrote the reason to spell out the literal {"assign": {"step": N, "landed_at": ..., "outcome": ...}} line; re-ran live and haiku landed it correctly (26s, exit 0, SessionEnd silent).

LIVE end-to-end #2 (fresh uuid): 3 clean lines — haiku launch assign, the HOOK action line for scratch.txt (repo-relative forward slashes, -05:00 offset), haiku landing assign. The Write on task.jsonl fired PostToolUse and was correctly skipped by the basename rule. Exec form (command node + args + ) confirmed working from a Windows-spawned process. Scratch dirs deleted; public/directory.json regenerated clean.

assign.outcome: **Ledger hooks built and proven live — one manual step left for Mike.** `.claude/hooks/ledger.mjs` (111 lines, node built-ins only) wires four events: PostToolUse appends one `action` line per file first-touched, Stop blocks an unfinished step ledger, SessionStart(resume)/SessionEnd append their lines. 36/36 fixtures plus three live `claude -p --model haiku` runs green. ⚠ `.claude/settings.json` COULD NOT BE WRITTEN — the auto-mode classifier denies both Write and Edit on it, and an agent may not authorize its own config change. The exact block to paste is in `.claude/hooks/readme.md` under Wiring; until Mike pastes it the hooks do nothing. Two live-only bugs fixed: a `Write`-created log has no trailing newline (the append glued two objects onto one line, silently voiding both), and the spec's Stop reason drew a malformed `{"landed_at": …}` top-level verb, so the reason now spells out the literal assign line.

log.msg: Orchestrator post-landing: settings.json merge was ALSO denied for the main session (update-config route) — two independent classifier denials on the same file reads as by-design: an AI must not wire its own hooks. The verified block waits in .claude/hooks/readme.md for Mike's paste. Softened CLAUDE.md + new-task SKILL.md so the hooks-own-edit-logging guidance is conditional on the merge — otherwise sessions in the gap would under-log.
